text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the summer training camp, an opportunity for one to show their skills as class representative. Sakura Bakushin O goes all out in her training, ready to be a perfect role model during her time there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus begins Sakura Bakushin O's passionate summer, the mantle of the fastest runner awaits her at the Sprinters Stakes!
